fields.Name: 1905 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For:: because of his outstanding merits as an epic writer

fields.Name: 2009 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For::
"who, with the concentration of poetry and the frankness of prose, depicts the
landscape of the dispossessed"

fields.Name: 1901 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For::
"in special recognition of his poetic composition, which gives evidence of lofty idealism,
artistic perfection and a rare combination of the qualities of both heart and intellect"

fields.Name: 1931 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For:: The poetry of Erik Axel Karlfeldt

fields.Name: 1973 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For::
"for an epic and psychological narrative art, which has introduced a new continent into
literature"

fields.Name: 1908 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For::
"in recognition of his earnest search for truth, his penetrating power of thought, his wide
range of vision, and the warmth and strength in presentation with which in 
his numerous works he has vindicated and developed an idealistic philosophy of life"

fields.Name: 1930 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For::
"for his vigorous and graphic art of description and his ability to create, 
with wit and humour, new types of characters"

fields.Name: 1977 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For::
"for a creative poetic writing, which illuminates man's condition in the cosmos and in 
present-day society, at the same time representing the great renewal of the traditions
of Spanish poetry between the wars"

fields.Name: 1922 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For::
"for the happy manner in which he has continued the illustrious traditions of the 
Spanish drama"

fields.Name: 1920 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For:: for his monumental work, Growth of the Soil

fields.Name: 1953 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For::
"for his mastery of historical and biographical description as well as for brilliant oratory 
in defending exalted human values"

fields.Name: 1904 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For::
"in recognition of the fresh originality and true inspiration of his poetic production, which
faithfully reflects the natural scenery and native spirit of his people, and, in addition, his 
significant work as a Provençal philologist"

fields.Name: 1948 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For:: for his outstanding, pioneer contribution to present-day poetry

fields.Name: 1995 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For::
"for works of lyrical beauty and ethical depth, which exalt everyday miracles 
and the living past"

fields.Name: 1962 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For::
"for his realistic and imaginative writings, combining as they do sympathetic humour 
and keen social perception"

fields.Name: 2013 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For:: master of the contemporary short story

fields.Name: 1958 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For::
"for his important achievement both in contemporary lyrical poetry and in the field of
the great Russian epic tradition"

fields.Name: 1987 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For:: for an all-embracing authorship, imbued with clarity of thought and poetic intensity

fields.Name: 1947 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For::
"for his comprehensive and artistically significant writings, in which human problems 
and conditions have been presented with a fearless love of truth and keen psychological 
insight"

fields.Name: 2023 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For:: “for his innovative plays and prose which give voice to the unsayable”

fields.Name: 1915 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For::
"as a tribute to the lofty idealism of his literary production and to the sympathy and love
of truth with which he has described different types of human beings"

fields.Name: 1988 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For::
"who, through works rich in nuance - now clear-sightedly realistic, now evocatively
ambiguous - has formed an Arabian narrative art that applies to all mankind"

fields.Name: 1982 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For::
"for his novels and short stories, in which the fantastic and the realistic are combined 
in a richly composed world of imagination, reflecting a continent's life and conflicts"

fields.Name: 1925 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For::
"for his work which is marked by both idealism and humanity, its stimulating satire often
being infused with a singular poetic beauty"

fields.Name: 1993 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For::
"who in novels characterized by visionary force and poetic import, gives life
to an essential aspect of American reality"

fields.Name: 1936 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For::
"for the power, honesty and deep-felt emotions of his dramatic works, which embody an
original concept of tragedy"

fields.Name: 1992 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For::
"for a poetic oeuvre of great luminosity, sustained by a historical vision, the 
outcome of a multicultural commitment"

fields.Name: 2006 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For::
"who in the quest for the melancholic soul of his native city has discovered
new symbols for the clash and interlacing of cultures"

fields.Name: 1933 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For::
"for the strict artistry with which he has carried on the classical Russian traditions 
in prose writing"

fields.Name: 2004 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For::
"for her musical flow of voices and counter-voices in novels and plays that with
extraordinary linguistic zeal reveal the absurdity of society's clichés and their 
subjugating power"

fields.Name: 1971 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For::
"for a poetry that with the action of an elemental force brings alive a continent's 
destiny and dreams"

fields.Name: 1934 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For:: for his bold and ingenious revival of dramatic and scenic art

fields.Name: 1928 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For:: principally for her powerful descriptions of Northern life during the Middle Ages

fields.Name: 1990 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For::
"for impassioned writing with wide horizons, characterized by sensuous intelligence 
and humanistic integrity"

fields.Name: 1974 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For:: for a narrative art, farseeing in lands and ages, in the service of freedom

fields.Name: 1974 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For:: for writings that catch the dewdrop and reflect the cosmos

fields.Name: 1949 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For:: for his powerful and artistically unique contribution to the modern American novel

fields.Name: 1970 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For::
"for the ethical force with which he has pursued the indispensable traditions of 
Russian literature"

fields.Name: 1985 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For::
"who in his novel combines the poet's and the painter's creativeness with a deepened 
awareness of time in the depiction of the human condition"

fields.Name: 1967 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For::
"for his vivid literary achievement, deep-rooted in the national traits and traditions 
of Indian peoples of Latin America"

fields.Name: 1963 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For:: for his eminent lyrical writing, inspired by a deep feeling for the Hellenic world of culture

fields.Name: 2021 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For:: “for his uncompromising and compassionate penetration of the effects of colonialism and the fate of the refugee in the gulf between cultures and continents”

fields.Name: 1997 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For::
"who emulates the jesters of the Middle Ages in scourging authority and upholding
the dignity of the downtrodden"

fields.Name: 1921 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For::
"in recognition of his brilliant literary achievements, characterized as they are by a 
nobility of style, a profound human sympathy, grace, and a true Gallic temperament"

fields.Name: 2016 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For:: for having created new poetic expressions within the great American song tradition

fields.Name: 1945 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For::
"for her lyric poetry, which inspired by powerful emotions, has made her name a 
symbol of the idealistic aspirations of the entire Latin American world"

fields.Name: 1986 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For::
"who in a wide cultural perspective and with poetic overtones fashions the drama
of existence"

fields.Name: 1968 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For::
"for his narrative mastery, which with great sensibility expresses the essence of 
the Japanese mind"

fields.Name: 2008 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For::
"author of new departures, poetic adventure and sensual ecstasy, explorer of
a humanity beyond and below the reigning civilization"

fields.Name: 1904 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For::
"in recognition of the numerous and brilliant compositions which, in an
individual and original manner, have revived the great traditions of the Spanish drama"

fields.Name: 2007 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For::
"that epicist of the female experience, who with scepticism, fire and visionary
power has subjected a divided civilisation to scrutiny"

fields.Name: 1919 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For:: in special appreciation of his epic, Olympian Spring

fields.Name: 1906 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For::
"not only in consideration of his deep learning and critical research, but above all as a 
tribute to the creative energy, freshness of style, and lyrical force which characterize
his poetic masterpieces"

fields.Name: 1938 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For::
"for her rich and truly epic descriptions of peasant life in China and for her
biographical masterpieces"

fields.Name: 1950 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For::
"in recognition of his varied and significant writings in which he champions humanitarian
ideals and freedom of thought"

fields.Name: 1913 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For::
"because of his profoundly sensitive, fresh and beautiful verse, by which, with
consummate skill, he has made his poetic thought, expressed in his own English words,
a part of the literature of the West"

fields.Name: 1954 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For::
"for his mastery of the art of narrative, most recently demonstrated in The Old Man 
and the Sea, and for the influence that he has exerted on contemporary style"

fields.Name: 2017 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For::
"who, in novels of great emotional force, has uncovered the abyss beneath 
our illusory sense of connection with the world"

fields.Name: 1957 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For::
"for his important literary production, which with clear-sighted earnestness illuminates 
the problems of the human conscience in our times"

fields.Name: 2005 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For::
"who in his plays uncovers the precipice under everyday prattle and forces
entry into oppression's closed rooms"

fields.Name: 1916 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For::
"in recognition of his significance as the leading representative of a new era in 
our literature"

fields.Name: 2014 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For::
"for the art of memory with which he has evoked the most ungraspable human
destinies and uncovered the life-world of the occupation"

fields.Name: 1998 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For::
"who with parables sustained by imagination, compassion and irony continually 
enables us once again to apprehend an elusory reality"

fields.Name: 1975 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For::
"for his distinctive poetry, which, with great artistic sensitivity, has interpreted human 
values under the sign of an outlook on life with no illusions"

fields.Name: 1984 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For::
"for his poetry, which endowed with freshness, and rich inventiveness provides a 
liberating image of the indomitable spirit and versatility of man"

fields.Name: 1959 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For::
"for his lyrical poetry, which with classical fire expresses the tragic experience of 
life in our own times"

fields.Name: 1976 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For::
"for the human understanding and subtle analysis of contemporary culture that are
combined in his work"

fields.Name: 1927 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For::
"in recognition of his rich and vitalizing ideas and the brilliant skill with which they 
have been presented"

fields.Name: 1937 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For::
"for the artistic power and truth with which he has depicted human conflict as well as 
some fundamental aspects of contemporary life in his novel cycle Les Thibault"

fields.Name: 1989 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For::
"for a rich and intensive prose, which with restrained compassion forms a challenging
vision of man's vulnerability"

fields.Name: 2018 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For:: “for a narrative imagination that with encyclopedic passion represents the crossing of boundaries as a form of life”

fields.Name: 1917 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For:: for his varied and rich poetry, which is inspired by lofty ideals

fields.Name: 1917 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For:: for his authentic descriptions of present-day life in Denmark

fields.Name: 1955 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For:: for his vivid epic power, which has renewed the great narrative art of Iceland

fields.Name: 2022 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For:: “for the courage and clinical acuity with which she uncovers the roots, estrangements and collective restraints of personal memory”

fields.Name: 1981 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For:: for writings marked by a broad outlook, a wealth of ideas and artistic power

fields.Name: 1946 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For::
"for his inspired writings, which while growing in boldness and penetration, 
exemplify the classical humanitarian ideals and high qualities of style"

fields.Name: 1923 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For::
"for his always inspired poetry, which in a highly artistic form gives expression to the
spirit of a whole nation"

fields.Name: 1966 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For::
"for her outstanding lyrical and dramatic writing, which interprets Israel's destiny 
with touching strength"

fields.Name: 1980 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For::
"who with uncompromising clear-sightedness voices man's exposed condition in 
a world of severe conflicts"

fields.Name: 1952 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For::
"for the deep spiritual insight and the artistic intensity with which he has in his novels 
penetrated the drama of human life"

fields.Name: 2011 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For::
"because, through his condensed, translucent images, he gives us fresh 
access to reality"

fields.Name: 1902 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For::
"the greatest living master of the art of historical writing, with special reference to 
his monumental work, A History of Rome"

fields.Name: 1924 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For:: for his great national epic, The Peasants

fields.Name: 1972 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For::
"for his writing, which through its combination of a broad perspective on his time 
and a sensitive skill in characterization has contributed to a renewal of German literature"

fields.Name: 1983 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For::
"for his novels, which with the perspicuity of realistic narrative art and the diversity 
and universality of myth, illuminate the human condition in the world of today"

fields.Name: 1996 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For::
"for poetry that with ironic precision allows the historical and biological context to
come to light in fragments of human reality"

fields.Name: 2019 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For:: “for an influential work that with linguistic ingenuity has explored the periphery and the specificity of human experience”

fields.Name: 1978 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For::
"for his impassioned narrative art which, with roots in a Polish-Jewish cultural tradition, 
brings universal human conditions to life"

fields.Name: 1994 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For::
"who with poetic force creates an imagined world, where life and myth condense to
form a disconcerting picture of the human predicament today"

fields.Name: 1991 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For::
"who through her magnificent epic writing has - in the words of Alfred Nobel -
been of very great benefit to humanity"

fields.Name: 1999 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For:: whose frolicsome black fables portray the forgotten face of history

fields.Name: 2010 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For::
"for his cartography of structures of power and his trenchant images of the
individual's resistance, revolt, and defeat"

fields.Name: 1939 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For::
"for his deep understanding of his country's peasantry and the exquisite art with which
he has portrayed their way of life and their relationship with Nature"

fields.Name: 2012 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For:: who with hallucinatory realism merges folk tales, history and the contemporary

fields.Name: 1907 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For::
"in consideration of the power of observation, originality of imagination, virility of ideas
and remarkable talent for narration that characterize the creations of this world-famous
author"

fields.Name: 1961 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For::
"for the epic force with which he has traced themes and depicted human destinies
drawn from the history of his country"

fields.Name: 2020 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For:: “for her unmistakable poetic voice that with austere beauty makes individual existence universal”

fields.Name: 2015 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For:: for her polyphonic writings, a monument to suffering and courage in our time

fields.Name: 1960 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For::
"for the soaring flight and the evocative imagery of his poetry, which in a visionary
fashion reflects the conditions of our time"

fields.Name: 1969 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For::
"for his writing, which - in new forms for the novel and drama - in the destitution
of modern man acquires its elevation"

fields.Name: 1912 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For::
"primarily in recognition of his fruitful, varied and outstanding production in the
realm of dramatic art"

fields.Name: 1926 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For::
"for her idealistically inspired writings, which with plastic clarity picture the life on her 
native island and with depth and sympathy deal with human problems in general"

fields.Name: 2001 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For::
"for having united perceptive narrative and incorruptible scrutiny in works 
that compel us to see the presence of suppressed histories"

fields.Name: 1910 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For::
"as a tribute to the consummate artistry, permeated with idealism, which he has
demonstrated during his long productive career as a lyric poet, dramatist, 
novelist and writer of world-renowned short stories"

fields.Name: 1911 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For::
"in appreciation of his many-sided literary activities, and especially of his dramatic works,
which are distinguished by a wealth of imagination and by a poetic fancy, which reveals,
sometimes in the guise of a fairy tale, a deep inspiration, while in a mysterious way they 
appeal to the readers' own feelings and stimulate their imaginations"

fields.Name: 2000 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For::
"for an oeuvre of universal validity, bitter insights and linguistic ingenuity, 
which has opened new paths for the Chinese novel and drama"

fields.Name: 1929 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For::
"principally for his great novel, Buddenbrooks, which has won steadily increased 
recognition as one of the classic works of contemporary literature"

fields.Name: 1909 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For::
"in appreciation of the lofty idealism, vivid imagination and spiritual perception that 
characterize her writings"

fields.Name: 2003 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For:: who in innumerable guises portrays the surprising involvement of the outsider

fields.Name: 1932 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For:: for his distinguished art of narration, which takes its highest form in The Forsyte Saga

fields.Name: 1903 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For::
"as a tribute to his noble, magnificent and versatile poetry, which has always been 
distinguished by both the freshness of its inspiration and the rare purity of its spirit"

fields.Name: 1979 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For::
"for his poetry, which, against the background of Greek tradition, depicts with 
sensuous strength and intellectual clear-sightedness modern man's struggle for freedom
and creativeness"

fields.Name: 1964 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For::
"for his work, which rich in ideas and filled with the spirit of freedom and the quest for
truth, has exerted a far-reaching influence on our age"

fields.Name: 1951 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For::
"for the artistic vigour and true independence of mind with which he endeavours in 
his poetry to find answers to the eternal questions confronting mankind"

fields.Name: 1965 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For::
"for his profoundly characteristic narrative art with motifs from the life of the 
Jewish people"

fields.Name: 2002 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For::
"for writing that upholds the fragile experience of the individual against the
barbaric arbitrariness of history"

fields.Name: 1956 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For::
"for his lyrical poetry, which in Spanish language constitutes an example of high 
spirit and artistical purity"

fields.Name: 1944 Nobel Prize for Literature -
fields.Nobel For::
"for the rare strength and fertility of his poetic imagination with which is combined an 
intellectual curiosity of wide scope and a bold, freshly creative style"
